steps.title: Vee notch plate: extrude the plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as notch_plate.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a rectangle 90 by 50.

steps.title: Vee notch plate: R20 corner
actions: Fillet: Radius 20, select the top left edge. OK.

steps.title: Vee notch plate: R10 corner
actions: Fillet: Radius 10, select the top right edge. OK.

steps.title: Vee notch plate: cut the 20 x 10 step
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw a rectangle 20 wide and 10 high at the bottom left corner.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Cut, Through All. OK.

steps.title: Vee notch plate: cut the vee notch
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw the vee: 15 wide on the top edge, starting 30 from the left, 10 deep, with its left side at 30 degrees to the vertical.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Cut, Through All. OK.

steps.title: Vee notch plate: hole 10 diameter
actions: Hole: Placement = on the front face, 15 from the right end (75 from the left) and 15 above the base. Simple hole, diameter 10, Through All. OK. Save.
steps.note: The 10 thickness is assumed (the slide shows one view only).
